visual_description: A client enters a refined EMS studio through a dark charcoal doorway. Warm soft orange practical lights reveal clean architectural lines, premium textures, defined shadows, and a calm editorial atmosphere.
voiceover: Uma nova forma de viver o treino começa no momento da entrada.
camera_movement: Slow forward dolly from the studio entrance, with a subtle low-angle rise as the client walks into frame.

visual_description: Detailed close-up of a client putting on the black EMS suit. Textured fabric, secure electrodes, and precise fastening are shown against a dark charcoal background with soft orange highlights.
voiceover: O fato EMS ajusta-se ao corpo para uma sessão orientada e precisa.
camera_movement: Macro lateral tracking shot across the suit, cutting to a smooth close-up of the fastening being secured.

visual_description: A qualified trainer calmly explains the session beside the client. The client stands in a balanced athletic position while the trainer checks the suit controls. High-contrast studio lighting keeps faces and equipment clearly visible.
voiceover: Com acompanhamento próximo, cada movimento encontra a posição certa.
camera_movement: Controlled shoulder-level orbit around trainer and client, ending on the trainer's hand checking the controls.

visual_description: The EMS session reaches its active phase. Close-ups show controlled movement, visible muscle contraction, and subtle suit indicators pulsing in soft orange. The mood is dynamic, focused, and cinematic without exaggeration.
voiceover: A WB-EMS ativa simultaneamente vários grupos musculares, com baixo impacto articular.
camera_movement: Dynamic push-in with a brief controlled slow-motion detail on the contraction, followed by a crisp cut back to the full movement.

visual_description: The client finishes the session, removes the EMS suit, and stands tall with a composed, satisfied expression. The studio remains dark charcoal with a soft orange rim light and clean white highlights.
voiceover: Em 20 a 25 minutos, fica a sensação de um treino completo e acompanhado.
camera_movement: Gentle arc around the client, moving from a close-up of the suit release to a confident medium portrait.

visual_description: Minimal final studio frame: the TechBody wordmark sits in white on a dark charcoal background, framed by a soft orange vertical light and defined shadows. The EMS suit rests neatly in the background.
camera_movement: Slow static-to-close push toward the TechBody wordmark, holding the final frame cleanly for the call to action.
